# Telecamere 1.0.0

First stable release of Telecamere.

- Minimal home with four previews ordered by North, North East, East, and South using Tuya camera names.
- Remote selection opens a camera full-screen in HD with audio when supported.
- GitHub update checks verify the APK with SHA-256; Android still asks the user to confirm installation.
- Requires Android 7 / API 24 or later. Fire OS 5 and Vega OS are not supported.
